_note: Hand-authored: v0.1.3 predates `trustabl capabilities`. Its loader is forward-compatible for scope / applies_to / category / predicate (it skips a rule it cannot evaluate) but HARD-FAILS the entire load on an unknown `language` value — the bug fixed in the engine's forward-compat language PR. The compat gate enforces ONLY the dimensions in hard_fail_dimensions, so for v0.1.3 only `languages` must be exhaustive here. Newer releases generate their descriptor with `trustabl capabilities > compat/<tag>.json` (fully forward-compatible builds report hard_fail_dimensions: []).
